name: Banh da tron
summary: Bánh đa trộn is thick, flat rice noodles topped with sausage, fried fish cakes, tofu, peanuts, and leafy vegetables. Thin glass noodles, miến, are another option from the same baskets.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi street-food article places the carrying pole in the Old Quarter.
howToEat: A vendor carries a steaming pot and a basket of raw ingredients on a shoulder pole. The noodles are topped with sausage, fried fish cakes, tofu, peanuts, and leafy vegetables.
where: Old Quarter, sold from a carrying pole.
seoTitle: Banh da tron — Hanoi mixed flat noodles
seoDescription: Bánh đa trộn in Hanoi’s Old Quarter is thick flat noodles with sausage, fried fish cakes, tofu, peanuts, and greens. Miến is the other noodle in the same baskets.
